reporting-org.narrative: Digital Impact Alliance at Capital For Good

description.narrative:
This program ensures that DIAL’s strategy translates into implementation by providing the operational backbone that enables programs to deliver on time, on budget, and in alignment with donor commitments, while maintaining compliance, financial integrity, and strong team performance. ProOps integrates project management, finance, contracts, operations, and talent management into a cohesive support system that enables delivery without over engineered processes.
The team collaboratively works across investments and functions to reduce friction, manage risk, and ensure that programs succeed in the complex and dynamic digital ecosystem:
Program Leads to support scope definition, scheduling, risk management, and reporting.
Investment Owners to ensure operational feasibility aligns with strategic ambition.
Strategic Alignment & Learning to integrate learning capture into implementation processes.
Leadership to surface operational risks, tradeoffs, and resource implications early.
Program Managers remain responsible for program outcomes. Program Operations ensures the systems and tools are in place to make those outcomes achievable and sustainable.
